svg.title: Equipotentials around two tilted plates
svg.desc: Computed equipotentials around two conducting plates that are closest at the left and spread apart toward the right; the top plate is positive and the bottom plate negative. Between the plates the equipotentials fan out from the narrow left end like the ribs of a partly open fan: they are crowded together where the plates are closest, so the field is strongest there, and spread apart toward the open right end. Around the outer edges they curve around the plates. Positive charge, shown by plus signs, sits mainly on the lower face of the top plate, and negative charge on the upper face of the bottom plate, most densely at the narrow end and at the corners. The potential increases from the bottom plate toward the top plate.
